Supreme Court to hear INDIA bloc plea on Election Commission questions

The Supreme Court has scheduled a hearing for December 9 on a plea filed by the INDIA bloc concerning 48 questions related to the Election Commission of India (ECI). The ECI has raised strong objections to the bloc's request to serve these interrogatories. The court will make a decision after hearing both sides.
